scope: Historical author-procedure replay for rna; the corrected production variance intentionally differs. All signed test flags checked against author outputs; four-decimal effect classification reproduces printed counts. This is not a claim that the public estimator yields the paper counts.
preprocessing: Keep all 4176 sequences; retain nucleotide offsets 0,1,5,26,42,45,65,68,69,70; preserve log fitness and SE. Replay uses variance=6*SE**2. Replay author duplicated-target variance, n=min(k_u,k_v), df=n-1, two-sided tests, separate all-pair BH families at FDR .01; classify effects after four-decimal formatting.

sources.locator: Results: EE mutations are more frequent but have smaller fitness effects in the RNA adaptive landscape; Supplementary Fig. S2.
